e3d.hint.select: Drag gizmo arrows, planes or rings · type a value · Tab cycles snaps · Ctrl — copy · Esc cancels
e3d.hint.box: Drag: left→right — window, right→left — crossing · Ctrl adds · Esc exits
e3d.hint.measure: Click points to measure · Tab cycles snaps · Esc clears
e3d.hint.wall: Click start and end on the work plane · type a length · Enter ends the chain · Esc exits
e3d.hint.floor: Click boundary points · click the first point or Enter closes · Esc exits
e3d.hint.column: Click to place a column on the work plane · Esc exits
e3d.hint.beam: Click two ends · on a vertical work plane the beam may slope · Esc exits
e3d.hint.face: Click a face to set the work plane · Esc exits
e3d.hint.pick: Click three points to set the work plane · Esc exits
e3d.wp.no_ref: No reference planes in the model
e3d.wp.collinear: Points are on one line — the plane is not defined

e3d.err.column_height: column height must be over 10 mm
e3d.err.copy: copying is not available for this element
e3d.err.floor_points: a floor needs at least 3 points
e3d.err.opening: the opening must be over 10 mm and stay inside its wall

e3d.err.unsupported: this element cannot be moved here
